title_zh: 全球健康与长寿每日简报
intro_zh: 每日汇总功能医学、长寿医学、精准营养、营养补剂与健康管理五大领域的中英文权威资讯，每条附原始出处链接。
intro_en: A daily digest of authoritative Chinese and international coverage across functional medicine, longevity medicine, precision nutrition, dietary supplements and health management — every item links to its original source.

items.title_zh: 湖南师大杨焕胜团队：丁酸梭菌与精氨酸联手，熄灭促肥胖巨噬细胞炎症
items.title_en: Hunan Normal University: Clostridium butyricum and arginine jointly extinguish pro-obesity macrophage inflammation
items.summary_zh: 湖南师范大学杨焕胜团队与印遇龙团队合作在Microbiome发表跨物种研究：肥胖机体肠道革兰氏阴性菌扩张、血清内毒素升高，LPS经EGR1转录因子驱动巨噬细胞M1极化，形成全身代谢性炎症。补充丁酸梭菌、丁酸或精氨酸，或抑制EGR1，均可显著减轻小鼠体重增幅、肝脂沉积并改善糖耐量，为肥胖的菌群-免疫联合干预给出清晰靶点。
items.summary_en: A cross-species study by Yang Huansheng's team at Hunan Normal University, published in Microbiome, shows that in obesity, expansion of gram-negative gut bacteria raises serum LPS, which drives M1 macrophage polarization via the EGR1 transcription factor and fuels systemic metabolic inflammation. Supplementing Clostridium butyricum, butyrate or arginine—or inhibiting EGR1—markedly reduced weight gain, hepatic fat and impaired glucose tolerance in mice, pointing to a clear microbiome-immune target for obesity intervention.

items.title_zh: 江南大学孙嘉/潘礼龙团队：一类特殊的大肠杆菌推动慢性胰腺炎走向纤维化
items.title_en: Jiangnan University: A distinctive E. coli drives chronic pancreatitis toward fibrosis
items.summary_zh: 江南大学孙嘉、潘礼龙团队联合上海交通大学邹多武等在Gastroenterology发表研究，整合多中心慢性胰腺炎患者宏基因组、小鼠模型与巨噬细胞实验，鉴定出一类高表达HtpG的大肠杆菌可促进胰腺纤维化，揭示了肠道菌群在慢性胰腺炎进展中的因果作用，为以微生态为靶点的胰腺疾病干预提供了机制依据。
items.summary_en: A team led by Sun Jia and Pan Lilong of Jiangnan University with Zou Duowu of Shanghai Jiao Tong University, publishing in Gastroenterology, integrated multi-center metagenomics from chronic pancreatitis patients with mouse models and macrophage experiments. They identified HtpG-high-expressing E. coli that promotes pancreatic fibrosis, establishing a causal role for gut microbes in disease progression and supporting microbiome-targeted strategies for pancreatic disorders.

items.title_zh: Nature Communications：重新审视脱硫弧菌，特定鞭毛蛋白瓦解肠道免疫耐受
items.title_en: Nature Communications: Rethinking Desulfovibrio — specific flagellins dismantle gut immune tolerance
items.summary_zh: Nature Communications发表的一项泛基因组研究系统解析了脱硫弧菌属的广泛基因组多样性，发现不同物种携带的功能性状差异显著，其中特定鞭毛蛋白能够破坏肠道免疫耐受，与炎症性肠病等疾病相关。该工作提示判断硫酸盐还原菌的致病潜力必须细化到物种与效应分子层面，而非停留在属水平。
items.summary_en: A pan-genomic study in Nature Communications systematically mapped the extensive genomic diversity of the genus Desulfovibrio, revealing pronounced species-specific functional traits. Certain flagellins were shown to undermine gut immune tolerance and have been linked to inflammatory bowel disease. The work suggests that assessing the pathogenic potential of sulfate-reducing bacteria requires species- and effector-level resolution rather than genus-level labels.

items.title_zh: Science Immunology：肠道上皮双哨兵，簇细胞联手M细胞重塑黏膜免疫
items.title_en: Science Immunology: Tuft cells team up with M cells as dual sentinels of mucosal immunity
items.summary_zh: Science Immunology发表的研究发现，肠道淋巴滤泡相关上皮中的簇细胞与M细胞形成功能协同：簇细胞放大2型黏膜免疫应答并促进IgA产生，与M细胞共同构成肠道黏膜免疫的"双哨兵"结构。该发现深化了对肠道上皮如何平衡免疫防御与耐受的理解，也为益生菌与黏膜疫苗设计提供了新的上皮靶点。
items.summary_en: Research published in Science Immunology shows that tuft cells in follicle-associated epithelium of the gut cooperate with M cells: tuft cells amplify type 2 mucosal immunity and boost IgA production, forming a dual-sentinel architecture with M cells. The finding deepens understanding of how the gut epithelium balances defense and tolerance, and suggests new epithelial targets for probiotic and mucosal vaccine design.

items.title_zh: ScienceDaily："僵尸细胞"如何躲避免疫系统追杀的机制被揭开
items.title_en: ScienceDaily: How harmful 'zombie cells' hide from the immune system
items.summary_zh: ScienceDaily报道的最新研究揭示了衰老细胞（"僵尸细胞"）逃避免疫清除的关键机制：它们通过特定的分子伪装躲过免疫系统的监视，从而在组织中持续累积并释放促炎因子，驱动慢性炎症与组织老化。理解这一"隐身术"为开发增强免疫清除衰老细胞的抗衰疗法提供了直接靶点，是衰老细胞清除策略的重要补充。
items.summary_en: New research covered by ScienceDaily reveals how senescent 'zombie cells' evade immune surveillance through specific molecular camouflage, allowing them to accumulate in tissues and secrete pro-inflammatory factors that drive chronic inflammation and tissue aging. Understanding this hiding mechanism offers direct targets for anti-aging therapies designed to boost immune clearance of senescent cells, complementing existing senolytic strategies.

items.title_zh: 一项长达47年的研究揭示：身体从多大年龄开始流失力量
items.title_en: A 47-year study reveals the age when the body starts losing strength
items.summary_zh: ScienceDaily报道一项跨越47年的纵向研究，绘制了人体肌肉力量随年龄变化的长期轨迹，确定了力量开始加速流失的关键年龄节点。该发现对长寿医学意义重大：力量下降是失能与死亡风险的强预测因子，锁定"窗口期"意味着抗阻训练与蛋白质营养干预可在力量明显滑坡前提前介入，为延长健康寿命给出可操作的时间表。
items.summary_en: A 47-year longitudinal study covered by ScienceDaily charted the long-term trajectory of muscle strength across aging and identified the critical age at which strength decline accelerates. Because declining strength strongly predicts disability and mortality, pinning down this window means resistance training and protein-focused nutrition can be deployed before the slide begins—an actionable timetable for extending healthspan.

items.title_zh: 给干细胞装上"抗衰发动机"：ATG5过表达让老年韧带伤口奇迹般愈合
items.title_en: Equipping stem cells with an anti-aging engine: ATG5 overexpression rejuvenates aged ligament healing
items.summary_zh: 发表于Open Medicine的研究发现，老年大鼠韧带愈合缓慢的根源在于间充质干细胞自噬能力下降。研究者通过基因技术让干细胞过表达自噬关键基因ATG5后移植，不仅促进胶原有序排列与血管新生，还将巨噬细胞从促炎M1型转为抗炎M2型，显著提升老年韧带修复力，为老年运动损伤的干细胞疗法提供了"先抗衰、再修复"的新思路。
items.summary_en: A study in Open Medicine traced slow ligament healing in aged rats to reduced autophagy in mesenchymal stem cells. By engineering the cells to overexpress the autophagy gene ATG5 before transplantation, researchers promoted organized collagen alignment and new vessel growth, and shifted macrophages from pro-inflammatory M1 to reparative M2 phenotypes, markedly improving healing—suggesting an 'anti-age the cell, then repair' strategy for geriatric musculoskeletal injuries.

items.title_zh: 阻断化疗后的"衰老毒素"：微小RNA miR-3155b精准关闭衰老分泌因子
items.title_en: Blocking post-chemotherapy 'senescence toxins': microRNA miR-3155b precisely shuts down SASP
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究鉴定出乳腺癌治疗后产生的微小RNA miR-3155b，它像精准"刹车片"一样直接关闭引发炎症与肿瘤复发的衰老分泌因子（SASP），且不伤害正常细胞。该发现把细胞衰老研究从"清除"扩展到"驯化"——在不杀死衰老细胞的前提下中和其有害分泌，为减轻放化疗副作用及更温和的抗衰干预提供了全新靶点。
items.summary_en: New research identifies microRNA miR-3155b, produced after breast cancer treatment, which acts as a precise brake that directly silences the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) driving inflammation and tumor recurrence—without harming healthy cells. The finding extends senescence research from 'clearance' to 'taming,' neutralizing harmful secretions while leaving senescent cells alive, and opens a fresh target for softer anti-aging interventions and fewer radio-chemotherapy side effects.

items.title_zh: 近20万人数据：深夜进食与肝病风险升高最多30%相关
items.title_en: Nearly 200,000 people: Late-night eating linked to up to 30% higher liver disease risk
items.summary_zh: 俄勒冈健康与科学大学团队分析近20万人数据发现，习惯深夜进食与代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病风险升高最多达30%相关，进食时序本身独立于总热量摄入构成风险因素。研究强调"什么时候吃"与"吃什么"同样重要，为 chrono-nutrition（时间营养学）在脂肪肝一级预防中的应用提供了大样本流行病学支持。
items.summary_en: Analyzing data from nearly 200,000 people, researchers at Oregon Health & Science University found that habitual late-night eating is associated with up to a 30% higher risk of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease, with meal timing acting as a risk factor independent of total caloric intake. The study underscores that 'when we eat' matters as much as 'what we eat,' providing large-scale epidemiological support for chrono-nutrition in primary prevention of fatty liver disease.

items.title_zh: 梅斯医学：一个月不吃肉就能年轻1.7岁？随机试验显示纯素饮食改写DNA甲基化
items.title_en: One meat-free month makes you 1.7 years younger? Randomized trial shows a vegan diet rewrites DNA methylation
items.summary_zh: 发表于MedComm的随机饮食干预研究纳入48名健康成年人，等热量条件下进行一个月纯素与高肉饮食对照：尽管体重无明显变化，纯素组DNA甲基化谱偏向抗炎、抑癌与衰老相关通路改善，免疫细胞构成趋向更抗炎的稳态，部分表观遗传指标提示生物学衰老放缓。研究者提醒观察期仅4周且样本有限，长期效应与临床意义仍需验证。
items.summary_en: A randomized dietary intervention published in MedComm assigned 48 healthy adults to isocaloric vegan versus high-meat diets for one month. With no significant weight change, the vegan group's DNA methylation profile shifted toward anti-inflammatory, cancer-suppressive and longevity-related pathways, with immune cell composition trending toward a calmer state and epigenetic markers suggesting slower biological aging. The authors caution that four weeks and a small sample warrant longer, larger studies.

items.title_zh: 英国营养学杂志：2.1万人队列显示高质量膳食使糖尿病风险降低14%–28%，炎症指标起中介作用
items.title_en: British Journal of Nutrition: In 21,476 adults, high-quality diets cut diabetes odds 14%–28%, partly via inflammation
items.summary_zh: 发表于British Journal of Nutrition的福清队列研究（21,476名成人）显示，膳食质量最高组的糖尿病风险较最低组低14%–28%，11项血液炎症标志物可解释约9%的关联。研究提示膳食质量部分通过降低系统性炎症改善代谢健康，为抗炎膳食干预提供人群证据。
items.summary_en: A Fuqing Cohort study of 21,476 adults published in the British Journal of Nutrition found that those with the highest diet quality had 14%–28% lower odds of diabetes than the lowest group, depending on the scoring system, with eleven circulating inflammatory markers mediating about 9% of the association. The results suggest diet quality partly protects metabolic health by dampening systemic inflammation, supporting anti-inflammatory dietary patterns as a precision-nutrition target.

items.title_zh: 昆明理工团队：发酵罗望子果肉重塑色氨酸代谢，缓解顽固便秘
items.title_en: Kunming University of Science and Technology: Fermented tamarind pulp reshapes tryptophan metabolism to relieve stubborn constipation
items.summary_zh: 昆明理工大学储传奇团队发表于Journal of Advanced Research的研究显示，灭活益生菌发酵的罗望子果肉可通过调节肠道色氨酸分解代谢与AhR-NLRP3信号轴，改善顽固性便秘模型。该研究把传统药食同源食材与菌群-代谢组学机制对接，为功能性食品干预功能性胃肠病提供了"发酵增效"的精准营养思路。
items.summary_en: A team led by Chu Chuanqi at Kunming University of Science and Technology, publishing in the Journal of Advanced Research, showed that heat-inactivated probiotic-fermented tamarind pulp alleviates refractory constipation by modulating gut tryptophan catabolism and the AhR-NLRP3 axis. By linking a traditional food-medicine ingredient to microbiome-metabolomics mechanisms, the work offers a 'fermentation-boosted' precision nutrition strategy for functional gastrointestinal disorders.

items.title_zh: NutraIngredients周报：荷兰植物成分新规、英国补剂广告、Ω-3走出鱼油、HTBA收购Specnova
items.title_en: Across the Nutraverse: Dutch botanical rules, UK supplement ads, omega-3s beyond fish oil, HTBA buys Specnova
items.summary_zh: NutraIngredients行业周报盘点：荷兰拟议的补剂新规（涉及南非醉茄、蛇足石杉碱等植物成分）可能迫使企业重新配方；英国补剂广告监管趋严；Ω-3产品创新正走出传统鱼油形态；HTBA收购脂质递送技术公司Specnova，显示吸收与递送技术成为补剂行业并购新热点。
items.summary_en: NutraIngredients' industry roundup: proposed Dutch supplement rules targeting botanicals such as ashwagandha and huperzine could force product reformulation; UK supplement advertising scrutiny is tightening; omega-3 innovation is moving beyond conventional fish oil formats; and HTBA's acquisition of lipid-delivery specialist Specnova signals that absorption and delivery tech is the new hotspot in supplement M&A.

items.title_zh: Lallemand加码亚洲代谢平衡市场：携手本地伙伴推进益生菌方案
items.title_en: Lallemand doubles down on metabolic balance in Asia, working with local partners
items.summary_zh: NutraIngredients报道，加拿大益生菌巨头Lallemand正聚焦"代谢平衡"主题深耕亚洲市场，通过与本地合作伙伴联合推进针对血糖、血脂与体重管理的益生菌与益生菌组合方案。该公司强调以临床证据与本地化配方适配亚洲人群饮食习惯，反映出全球益生菌企业正从泛肠道健康转向代谢健康细分赛道。
items.summary_en: NutraIngredients reports that Canadian probiotics major Lallemand is focusing on 'metabolic balance' across Asia, partnering with local players to advance probiotic and synbiotic formulations aimed at blood glucose, blood lipids and weight management. The company stresses clinical evidence and localization to Asian dietary habits—reflecting a wider industry shift from generic gut health toward the metabolic health segment.

items.title_zh: 代谢健康补剂新品潮：瞄准肠道健康、血糖控制与饱腹感三大方向
items.title_en: Metabolic health supplement launches target gut health, glucose control and satiety
items.summary_zh: NutraIngredients汇总最新一波代谢健康补剂上市动态：新品集中主打肠道健康、血糖平稳与饱腹管理三大方向，普遍采用益生菌、膳食纤维、植物提取物与微量营养素的复配策略，并强调临床数据背书。代谢综合征高发叠加GLP-1时代消费者"自然辅助"需求，使该品类成为补剂行业增长最快的细分市场之一。
items.summary_en: NutraIngredients rounds up the latest wave of metabolic health supplement launches centered on gut health, glucose control and satiety. New products typically combine probiotics, fibers, botanical extracts and micronutrients, with an emphasis on clinical substantiation. Rising metabolic syndrome prevalence plus consumers seeking 'natural adjuncts' in the GLP-1 era make this one of the fastest-growing supplement categories.

items.title_zh: 十亿美元级补剂并购成新基准？行业整合加速洗牌
items.title_en: Are billion-dollar supplement deals becoming the new benchmark?
items.summary_zh: NutraIngredients分析指出，补剂行业正迎来十亿美元量级的并购交易潮，头部品牌与原料商的整合明显提速，资本向拥有临床证据、供应链掌控力与多市场渠道的标的集中。分析认为，科学背书与合规能力正在取代营销概念成为估值核心，行业将加速从"营销驱动"转向"证据驱动"的整合洗牌。
items.summary_en: NutraIngredients analysis shows the supplement sector is seeing a wave of billion-dollar-scale acquisitions, with consolidation accelerating among leading brands and ingredient suppliers. Capital is flowing toward targets with clinical evidence, supply-chain control and multi-market distribution. Scientific substantiation and compliance capability are replacing marketing hype as the core of valuation, driving the industry from marketing-led to evidence-led restructuring.

items.title_zh: ScienceDaily：Ozempic与Wegovy与罕见突发性视力丧失风险相关
items.title_en: ScienceDaily: Ozempic and Wegovy linked to rare risk of sudden vision loss
items.summary_zh: ScienceDaily报道的最新研究提示，GLP-1类药物司美格鲁肽（Ozempic/Wegovy）与罕见突发视力丧失——非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变（NAION）风险相关。研究并未否定GLP-1的代谢获益，但提示用药者出现视力变化应及时就医，为慢病管理中的用药监测再添一环。
items.summary_en: Research covered by ScienceDaily suggests GLP-1 drugs semaglutide (Ozempic/Wegovy) are associated with non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION), a rare cause of sudden vision loss. The finding does not negate the drugs' metabolic benefits, but patients noticing visual changes should seek prompt evaluation. It adds a new item to GLP-1 safety profiles and to monitoring practices in chronic disease management.

items.title_zh: 北大首钢医院"减重控糖"数智化慢病共管项目获评年度健康促进创新案例
items.title_en: Peking University Shougang Hospital's digital weight-and-glucose co-management project wins national health promotion innovation award
items.source_zh: 北京市卫生健康委员会
items.summary_zh: 北京市卫健委报道，北京大学首钢医院"减重控糖"数智化慢病共管项目从全国171项申报中脱颖而出，获评中国医院协会年度健康促进创新案例。项目覆盖首钢职工1076人，人均减重3.48公斤、成功率80.3%，超半数参与者血压血脂改善，展示职场慢病"体检-评估-干预-追踪"闭环模式。
items.summary_en: Beijing's Health Commission reports that Peking University Shougang Hospital's digital 'weight and glucose co-management' project was selected from 171 nationwide entries as a China Hospital Association 2025-2026 Health Promotion Innovation Case. Covering 1,076 Shougang Group employees, it delivered an average weight loss of 3.48 kg with an 80.3% success rate among those with valid data, and improved blood pressure and lipids in over half of participants—showcasing a workplace chronic-disease model of screening, assessment, personalized intervention and follow-up.

items.title_zh: VTN未来健康峰会发布"1+N"抗炎营养与长寿健康方案，成立V健康研究院
items.title_en: VTN Future Health Summit unveils '1+N' anti-inflammatory nutrition and longevity solution, launches V Health Research Institute
items.summary_zh: 10月11日举办的VTN未来健康峰会发布以抗炎营养餐为核心的"1+N"方案："1"为普适基础营养底盘，"N"为面向血糖维稳、肠道修复、血管养护等场景的个性化长寿健康方案，并联合多位国际科学家成立V健康研究院。抗炎、长寿营养正从概念走向平台化产品与服务生态，反映国内健康管理消费端的新趋势。
items.summary_en: At the VTN Future Health Summit held on October 11, the company launched a '1+N' solution: '1' is a universal foundational nutrition base, while 'N' offers personalized longevity plans for scenarios such as glucose stability, gut repair and vascular care, alongside a new V Health Research Institute with international scientists. Anti-inflammatory and longevity nutrition is moving from concept to platform-based products and service ecosystems, marking a notable consumer-health trend in China.

items.title_zh: 为什么一些运动恢复方法会适得其反？科学家揭示背后的生理机制
items.title_en: Scientists reveal why some workout recovery tricks can backfire
items.summary_zh: ScienceDaily报道的新研究解释了为何冰浴、按摩、压缩服等流行的运动恢复手段可能适得其反：运动后的炎症信号本身是肌肉适应与增强的必要刺激，过度抑制这些信号反而削弱训练效果。研究提示恢复策略应与训练目标匹配——追求表现提升时应"保留"适度炎症，仅在与训练负荷匹配的场景下使用恢复干预，为科学健身管理提供了新依据。
items.summary_en: New research covered by ScienceDaily explains why popular recovery tools such as ice baths, massage and compression garments can backfire: post-exercise inflammatory signaling is a necessary stimulus for muscle adaptation and strengthening, and suppressing it too aggressively blunts training gains. Recovery strategies should match training goals—preserving moderate inflammation when adaptation is the aim—which offers fresh guidance for evidence-based exercise management.
